approved_binary_policy: Selected transformed masters/final poses/brand exports and font binaries are explicitly allowed. Raw personal identity/voice sources, opaque provider outputs, SFX raws and derived standalone closure audio are excluded.
logical_voice_reference: Engin voice logical ID in voice/decision.json is not an API/session credential; second machine still needs its own authorized connector access.
scope_limits: Heuristic pattern scan cannot prove absence of all secrets.
No credential values, private URL values, cookies or surrounding contexts are copied to this report.
Exact candidate-list hash is the scan boundary; rerun after candidate set changes.
This report scans itself only if present in the incoming manifest; self-referential hash is not a content-preservation claim.
